title: Alpha is live, but nobody to compete in 1v1 . Need help reaching players
author: ImaginationReal9192
selftext:
I've been building a 2-player online fighting game, and it's in alpha now. I had never built a game before, so I asked Claude to teach me how. I didn't have it generate all the code. It explained the concepts, and I wrote and figured out most of it myself. The game works, but I'm stuck on the hardest part: getting people to actually try it. Online play is no fun when there's nobody to play against.

Could you give it 5 minutes and tell me:

What's confusing or broken?

What would make you want to come back?

Where would you share a game like this?

Even one piece of advice on reaching players would help a lot.

Link: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.FireFrostSerpent.game

Thank you, it means a lot.

comments.author: Neat_Poet2249
comments.body: Bro, be honest. Would you actually enjoy playing this game for 30 minutes straight?

replies.author: ImaginationReal9192
replies.body: I enjoy playing this game myself, and I only wish more people would give it a chance. I just want people to experience what I've created, even if it's only once.

comments.author: PositiveScarcity8909
comments.body:
Nice learning exercise, now go back and to make something else and learn more.

Hopefully in time you will make a real game.

comments.author: Slowsomer
comments.body:
It's incredibly obvious you haven't curated ANY part of this game. Every single UI screen reeks of you asking an AI to make it for you with zero refinement. Bad spacing, not centered, etc.

If you don't care about your game, why should i?

replies.author: ImaginationReal9192
replies.body: First of all I'm working on my phone not in a pc or laptop, and Godot mobile version doesn't accept ai codes , yes I used ai to learn to build my game but it doesn't mean I build the whole game  just with a single prompt

replies.author: ImaginationReal9192
replies.body: If i used ai to make the whole game i would have also command Ai to  place the ui at the centre
